summary: The World Cup has begun.
content_text: The 2026 World Cup is officially underway, with co-host Mexico opening the tournament Thursday with a 2-0 win over South Africa at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City. Julián Quiñones gave El Tri an early lead with the first goal of the tournament just nine minutes in, before Raúl Jiménez doubled the advantage in the second half to secure the victory in the opening match. It was a historic setting for the start of the competition, with Estadio Azteca becoming the first stadium to host matches at three different men's World Cups, having previously staged games in 1970 and 1986. The action continued Thursday night in Guadalajara as South Korea overcame Czechia for a 2-1 win at Estadio Akron to close out the opening day of group stage play. Czechia's Ladislav Krejcí got the scoring started in the second half on a header after a brilliant throw-in assist from Vladimir Coufal. South Korea responded in kind moments later with a slick move by Hwang In-beom to level the match at 1-1 and then Oh Hyeon-gyu gave Korea the winner in the 80th minute with a quick flick on a cross. All told, it made for an eventful opening day of the World Cup. Final: Mexico 2 - 0 South Africa Final: Korea Republic 2, Czechia 1 See how the first day of the 2026 World Cup played out below.
